title: Zig: Functions
description: Write a function that adds two integers and returns the result.

steps.title: Add Function
steps.description: Write a function `fn add(a: i32, b: i32) i32` that returns the sum. In main(), call it with 10 and 20 and print the result.
hints: Zig functions: `fn add(a: i32, b: i32) i32 { return a + b; }`
No arrow syntax — just `fn name(params) ReturnType { body }`.
